metadata.title: I guess we will have 30 gold medals

messages.content: Which means 10K teams in this competition! Can we apply for a Guinness World Record together😄
i think it's because of ai agents usage rise, that people are participating more and more
That's definitely part of it, but there's also 6 other competitions going on and none are even close to the popularity of this contest.

live leaderboard feedback is awesome and thats why people like it. RL/heuristics writing is much easier with AI Agents so its the most fun for people, even if they make their AI agent implement everything.
Agreed, this is basically an idle game for me, that also has a learning component.

I guess this just shows how exciting this competition really is.

I’m drawn to it too. Like chess, the fun comes from complex interactions under simple rules.
It's challenging, but that's what makes it engaging.

I aimed for my first submission this weekend, but the difficulty is quite high. 😆
Bravo for the 30 gold medals @yiheng
Crazy. I wonder what makes this competition so popular

Just take a look at the other competitions topic:

・AI attacks

・Cell division

・Bone diagnosis

・And the notoriously brutal ARC

compared to all that, kaggriculture is all peace and love.
